verdict.rationale: The core TruffleHog scanner is open source and runs entirely in your own environment via a local binary (brew), Docker, or the CLI, and release artifacts are checksummed and signed with cosign. A community note confirms v3 is AGPL-licensed. The getting-started docs also offer self-hosted scanners for the commercial platform, as an alternative to hosted ones managed by Truffle Security. Missing for 10: detailed deployment docs for self-hosting the full enterprise stack (web UI, alerting), and SSO/RBAC are unavailable in the open-source edition per the comparison table.
